name: Ray Casting with Jittered Sampling
definition: A volume rendering technique that casts rays through a 3D texture (voxel grid) and accumulates color and opacity along the ray path. It uses jittered sampling to reduce aliasing artifacts and supports optional lighting computation.
summary: Ray Casting with Jittered Sampling is a volume rendering technique that perturbs sample positions using a pre-computed jitter texture to break up regular grid patterns and reduce aliasing artifacts.
